name: TOS Reception Map v1.0
method: Constituency and citation map of Charls Pearson's Theory of Operational Semiotics; every node and edge carries a verification field; reported items are typed as such and are work-queue entries, not findings.

nodes.label: Charls Pearson (1932-2021)
nodes.notes: First Ph.D. in semiotics granted by an American university (Georgia Tech, 1977). SSA founding member, Executive Committee; founder of SIG/ES, SIG/SE, SIG/STAR; ASIS member and founder of its SIG for Foundations of Information Science; applications sought in language, logic, music, law; 'rich if idiosyncratic' development of the Semiotic Paradigm with USST and TOS.

nodes.label: The Theory of Operational Semiotics (Semiotics 1998, PDC, pp. 140-155, DOI 10.5840/cpsem199816)
The Semiotic Paradigm View of Theoretical Semiotics (Trifonas ed., International Handbook of Semiotics, Springer, pp. 135-180, DOI 10.1007/978-94-017-9404-6_5)
nodes.source: link.springer.com chapter page; Springer TOC; WorldCat
nodes.notes: Mature restatement: USST static / TOS dynamic; operator functions; paradigm-completeness claim; recruits successors. 1998 is NOT the terminal statement.

nodes.label: Beyond Peirce: The New Science of Semiotics and the Semiotics of Law (2008; jurisology)
Universal Sign Structure Theory (USST; USST-2000 adopted by SSA Committee on Empirical Standards as standard static macro theory)
nodes.verification: verified via Pearson's own published abstract (2026-08-25)

nodes.label: Cary Campbell
nodes.source: ResearchGate 2019 Peirce Section intro; CSS interview DOI 10.1515/css-2020-0018; NASS XII program
nodes.notes: 2019 CSS Peirce section 'Celebrating Charls Pearson'; 2020 preservation interview; 2021 USST application to Peircean perceptual meaning, presented in memoriam; extension toward learning theory. USST uptake, not clearly TOS uptake.

nodes.label: Robert S. Hatten
nodes.notes: Collaborated with Pearson on a pair of articles on musical analogues of linguistic aspect; memorialist; sympathetic colleague, not a TOS disciple.

nodes.label: Vladimir Slamecka
nodes.source: SSA Semiotic Scene TOC; ERIC ED107229
nodes.notes: Georgia Tech co-lineage: A Theory of Sign Structure (1977); Informatics as a Semiotic Discipline (1982); NSF-supported semiotic foundations of information science. Pre-TOS soil.

nodes.label: Sean Day
nodes.notes: 2007 experimental program using synesthesia to investigate semantic sign structure — empirical-program uptake, not TOS adoption.

nodes.label: World Association for Theoretical Semiotics (WATS/IASS)
nodes.notes: Pearson president; ~30 members incl. Sonesson, Brier, Fernandez, McCurdy, Du Shi-hong. Constituency, not doctrine.

nodes.label: Chinese Semiotic Studies / Chinese semiotics network
nodes.verification: partially verified: China role verified via SSA obituary (peoples' ambassador; edited Chinese Journal of Semiotics; lectured widely; DIRECTED GRADUATE THESES); CSS Peirce-section editorship and advisory listings reported
nodes.notes: Strongest institutional afterlife outside SSA; probable undercounted thesis lineage — the priority dig.

nodes.label: Music (tense/aspect analogues; USST+TOS applied to nonlinguistic sign systems)
nodes.verification: collaboration verified via obituary; the named work reported

nodes.label: Information science (Georgia Tech 1970s; ASIS SIG/FIS)
nodes.verification: ASIS SIG/FIS founding verified via obituary; NSF program reported

bibliometric_note: SciSpace reports two citations to the 1998 TOS paper, both Pearson's own later works — REPORTED and explicitly non-ground-truth; the pattern (development of TOS as recursive self-elaboration 1998 → 2008 law → 2015 Handbook) is the finding, not the number.
negative_finding: No identified evidence of Pearsonian TOS as a recognized framework in operational research, organizational semiotics, AI/ML, semiotic management, or generic signs-as-actions literature — exactly the five neighborhoods the audited 2026-08-25 composition merged into its umbrella entity. The merger has no basis even in TOS's own reception.
